title: Transpose an existing fixed-field factor on one overlap
statement: Fix E ≤ F and a commutative span W -> U,V -> X. Take E-module objects P,Q on U,V, an Omega-module M on X, and arbitrary Omega-linear maps from the scalar extensions of P,Q to the respective pullbacks of M. An E-linear map from p*P to the restriction of q*(F tensor_E Q), transported along the specified overlap E-ring comparison, whose composite with q* of the canonical F-adjoint equals p* of the original E-to-Omega adjoint followed by the overlap comparison, transposes to an underlying sheaf map p*(F tensor_E P) -> q*(F tensor_E Q) commuting with the canonical F-adjoints. No finite presentation, finite family, qcqs, stage-existence or invertibility hypothesis is used.

source.place: (Obj) descent paragraph, finite-stage comparisons on pairwise overlaps

proof.text: The finite local model is definitionally the specified scalar extension. The scalar-extension transitivity isomorphism carries the composite E-to-F and F-to-Omega units to the E-to-Omega unit. The proved equality to the canonical adjunct identifies the explicit underlying local adjoint with the mixed scalar map followed by the supplied Omega-linear map. Use the component presentation of the specified square comparison. Its equality to upperStarCompIso follows by specializing the generic reconstruction identity; no source-library definition is changed.

For a monoidal left adjoint, compose the lifted module Hom equivalence with the scalar-extension Hom equivalence. Naturality of the adjunction unit identifies the two right adjoints. The resulting Hom equivalence is precomposition with the pulled scalar unit on underlying maps. In particular it supplies a lift and detects equality.

Naturality and monoidality of the overlap comparison identify the restriction of q* of the F-module with restriction along the pulled E-to-F ring map and the comparison at F. Transpose b through the preceding equivalence. Both composites into the restricted pullback of M are F-linear. Their precompositions with the pulled unit agree by hb and the unit-transitivity calculation, so injectivity gives equality. Forget linearity to obtain the required underlying sheaf map; the finite local model is already the specified scalar extension.

theorem finiteCoefficient_overlap_factor_transpose
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ T) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
    (U V W : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (h : V ⟶ X)
    (p : W ⟶ U) (q : W ⟶ V) (w : p ≫ g = q ≫ h)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)))
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    (Q : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology V) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    (a : (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).map
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)))).obj P ⟶
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).mapMod
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))).obj M)
    (c : (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).map
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)))).obj Q ⟶
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).mapMod
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))).obj M)
    (F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (hEF : E ≤ F)
    (rE : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).obj ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))) ⟶
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} q).obj ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    [IsMonHom rE]
    (hrE : rE = (overlapComparison w).hom.app
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)))
    (b : ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).mapMod
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)))).obj P ⟶
      (Mod.comap rE).obj (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} q).mapMod
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).obj
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E)))).obj
        ((Mod.comap ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} h).map
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjMap T ℓ hEF)))).obj
          (finiteCoefficientLocalModel T X f ℓ E V h Q F hEF))))
    (hb : b.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} q).map
        (finiteCoefficientLocalAdjoint T X f ℓ E V h Q M c F hEF).hom =
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).map
        ((Mod.extendUnit ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} g).map
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E))) P).hom ≫
            a.hom) ≫ (overlapComparison w).hom.app M.X) :
    ∃ s : (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).obj
        (finiteCoefficientLocalModel T X f ℓ E U g P F hEF).X ⟶
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} q).obj
        (finiteCoefficientLocalModel T X f ℓ E V h Q F hEF).X,
      s ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} q).map
        (finiteCoefficientLocalAdjoint T X f ℓ E V h Q M c F hEF).hom =
      (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).map
        (finiteCoefficientLocalAdjoint T X f ℓ E U g P M a F hEF).hom ≫
          (overlapComparison w).hom.app M.X
